title: The Covenant Confirmed

questions.question: Who went up the mountain with Moses?
options: Aaron, Nadab, Abihu, and seventy elders
questions.correctAnswer: Aaron, Nadab, Abihu, and seventy elders
questions.explanation: Exodus 24:1 (ESV): "Come up to the Lord, you and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel."

questions.question: What did Moses write down?
options: All the words of the Lord
questions.correctAnswer: All the words of the Lord
questions.explanation: Exodus 24:4 (ESV): "Moses wrote down all the words of the Lord."

questions.question: What did Moses throw on the people to seal the covenant?
questions.explanation: Exodus 24:8 (ESV): "Moses took the blood and threw it on the people."

questions.question: How long was Moses on the mountain?
questions.explanation: Exodus 24:18 (ESV): "Moses entered the cloud and went up on the mountain. And Moses was on the mountain forty days and forty nights."

questions.question: What did the glory of the Lord look like on the mountain?
options: A devouring fire on top of the mountain
questions.correctAnswer: A devouring fire on top of the mountain
questions.explanation: Exodus 24:17 (ESV): "Now the appearance of the glory of the Lord was like a devouring fire on the top of the mountain."

questions.question: What did the people say when Moses read them the book of the covenant?
options: All that the Lord has spoken we will do, and we will be obedient
questions.correctAnswer: All that the Lord has spoken we will do, and we will be obedient
questions.explanation: Exodus 24:7 (ESV): "All that the Lord has spoken we will do, and we will be obedient."

questions.question: What did Moses call the blood he sprinkled?
questions.explanation: Exodus 24:8 (ESV): "Behold the blood of the covenant that the Lord has made with you."

questions.question: What remarkable thing happened when the elders saw God?
questions.explanation: Exodus 24:11 (ESV): "He did not lay his hand on the chief men of the people of Israel; they beheld God, and ate and drank."

questions.question: Who did Moses leave in charge when he went up the mountain?
questions.explanation: Exodus 24:14 (ESV): "He said to the elders, 'Wait here for us... And behold, Aaron and Hur are with you. Whoever has a dispute, let him go to them.'"

questions.question: What was under God's feet when the elders saw Him?
options: A pavement of sapphire stone, clear as the sky
questions.correctAnswer: A pavement of sapphire stone, clear as the sky
questions.explanation: Exodus 24:10 (ESV): "There was under his feet as it were a pavement of sapphire stone, like the very heaven for clearness."

questions.question: What did God promise to give Moses on the mountain?
options: Tablets of stone with the law and commandment
questions.correctAnswer: Tablets of stone with the law and commandment
questions.explanation: Exodus 24:12 (ESV): "I will give you the tablets of stone, with the law and the commandment, which I have written for their instruction."

questions.question: How many pillars did Moses set up according to the tribes?
options: Twelve pillars for the twelve tribes
questions.correctAnswer: Twelve pillars for the twelve tribes
questions.explanation: Exodus 24:4 (ESV): "And built an altar at the foot of the mountain, and twelve pillars, according to the twelve tribes of Israel."

questions.question: Who went partway up the mountain with Moses before he went alone?
questions.explanation: Exodus 24:13 (ESV): "Moses rose with his assistant Joshua, and Moses went up into the mountain of God."

questions.question: How long did the cloud cover the mountain before God called Moses?
questions.explanation: Exodus 24:16 (ESV): "The glory of the Lord dwelt on Mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it six days. And on the seventh day he called to Moses."

questions.question: What animals were sacrificed as peace offerings?
questions.explanation: Exodus 24:5 (ESV): "He sent young men of the people of Israel, who offered burnt offerings and sacrificed peace offerings of oxen to the Lord."

key_verse_text: All that the Lord has spoken we will do, and we will be obedient.
